genxml.title: constants of the multi-node console and master election
genxml.doc: Constants that the multi-node module system controller arrangement uses: the hub network-interface scratch registers the master election reads, the CPU-letter base of the console line prefix, and the two-wire device family codes of the module and node records on the hub bus. Each is read from the PROM and kernel reading described in the console note; none has been checked against the images in this repository.
